openQuestions.title: Bundle a small local font for the load demo
openQuestions.detail: The dynamic FontFace load depends on fonts.gstatic.com, which fails offline (handled honestly today). Shipping a tiny same-origin woff2 would make the success path demonstrable in restricted networks too.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Verify semantic controls, live-region announcements for async state, visible focus, and honest unsupported states rather than fake success.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review-only critique (no frontend change shipped with it): the rubric applied this guidance as the review bar; the page itself was not modified.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless-Chrome CDP drive of the page's controls on 2026-08-16 with console/network capture.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: check("bold 32px system-ui") → true, Roboto FontFace load failed with an honest offline NetworkError message (external fonts.gstatic.com blocked in sandbox), banner correctly reports the interface object is not exposed; zero console errors.
